descriptionHtml:
ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 3050 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6 Graphics Card

Unlock exceptional 1080p gaming performance with the ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 3050 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6 graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by the advanced NVIDIA Ampere architecture with dedicated 2nd Gen RT Cores and 3rd Gen Tensor Cores, this powerhouse layout is equipped with a full 8GB profile of fast GDDR6 VRAM running on a solid 128-bit memory interface. The dual-fan thermal shroud incorporates premium high-airflow Axial-tech fans featuring smaller hubs, longer blades, and barrier rings to perfectly focus downward air pressure. Enhanced by a protective rigid backplate for structural durability and built using Auto-Extreme automated manufacturing technology, this factory overclocked card delivers incredible reliability and high frame rates. It comes complete with a dedicated 8-pin power delivery layout and is officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
